model_errors.xwoba: xwoba needs tracked pitch locations or batted-ball data, which most Double-A parks do not have
model_errors.swing: swing needs tracked pitch locations or batted-ball data, which most Double-A parks do not have
model_errors.battrack: battrack needs tracked pitch locations or batted-ball data, which most Double-A parks do not have
model_errors.catchprob: catchprob needs tracked pitch locations or batted-ball data, which most Double-A parks do not have
model_errors.framing: framing needs tracked pitch locations or batted-ball data, which most Double-A parks do not have

note: Pitch by pitch from MLB's game feeds: every pitch's count and call, the charted location, the batted-ball type, direction and the official scorer's hard / medium / soft at every park; velocity, spin, exit velocity and launch angle only where Hawk-Eye tracks the park, and no park at this level was tracked this season. Columns that need tracking are left out where there is none.

metrics.label: G (with a PA)
metrics.desc: Games with a plate appearance (defensive replacements and pinch runners without a PA are not counted).

metrics.label: AB
metrics.desc: At-bats: PA minus walks, HBP, sacrifices and catcher's interference.

metrics.label: uBB
metrics.desc: Unintentional walks (MLB's BB includes IBB: add the IBB column).

metrics.label: OBP
metrics.desc: (H + BB + IBB + HBP) / (AB + BB + IBB + HBP + SF).

metrics.label: wOBA
metrics.desc: Savant's woba_value summed over woba_denom: linear weights of each PA result, scaled to OBP.

metrics.label: Zone% seen
metrics.desc: Share of pitches seen in the strike zone (Savant zones 1-9).

metrics.label: Z-Swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at pitches in the zone.

metrics.label: Chase%
metrics.desc: Swings at pitches outside the zone (O-Swing%).

metrics.label: Contact%
metrics.desc: Contact (fouls and balls in play) per swing.

metrics.label: Z-Contact%
metrics.desc: Contact per swing in the zone.

metrics.label: O-Contact%
metrics.desc: Contact per swing outside the zone.

metrics.label: Whiff%
metrics.desc: Swinging strikes (incl. foul tips) per swing.

metrics.label: CSW% against
metrics.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per pitch.

metrics.label: First-pitch swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at the first pitch of a PA.

metrics.label: First-pitch strike% seen
metrics.desc: First pitches that were strikes (called, swinging, foul or in play).

metrics.label: Two-strike whiff%
metrics.desc: Whiffs per swing with two strikes.

metrics.label: Heart swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at pitches in the heart of the zone (attack zones).

metrics.label: Chase-zone swing%
metrics.desc: Swings in the chase band (133-200 % of the zone).

metrics.label: Waste swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at waste pitches (beyond 200 % of the zone).

metrics.label: GB%
metrics.desc: Ground balls per ball in play.

metrics.label: Hard%
metrics.desc: Balls in play the official scorer charted as hard hit (levels without exit velocity).

metrics.label: Soft%
metrics.desc: Balls in play the official scorer charted as softly hit.

metrics.label: Pull%
metrics.desc: Spray angle more than 15 degrees to the pull side.

metrics.label: Oppo%
metrics.desc: More than 15 degrees to the opposite field.

metrics.label: Pull-air%
metrics.desc: Pulled line drives and fly balls per ball in play (the most valuable batted-ball direction).

metrics.label: Oppo-air%
metrics.desc: Opposite-field line drives and fly balls.

metrics.label: Run value/100 (heart)
metrics.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the heart attack zone.

metrics.label: Run value/100 (shadow)
metrics.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the shadow attack zone.

metrics.label: Run value/100 (chase)
metrics.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the chase attack zone.

metrics.label: Run value/100 (waste)
metrics.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the waste attack zone.

metrics.label: Shadow swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at pitches on the edges (shadow attack zone).

metrics.label: PA share v LHP
metrics.desc: Share of the hitter's PAs against left-handers.

metrics.label: Platoon gap
metrics.desc: |wOBA v same-handed pitchers - wOBA v opposite-handed| (switch hitters: |v LHP - v RHP|).

metrics.label: WPA
metrics.desc: Win probability added: the change in our win expectancy (Markov model on inning, half, outs, bases, score) over the hitter's PAs.

metrics.label: WPA/LI
metrics.desc: Context-neutral wins: sum of WPA / leverage.

metrics.label: pLI
metrics.desc: Average leverage index of the hitter's PAs (1 = average).

metrics.label: RE24
metrics.desc: Run expectancy added over the hitter's PAs (runs).

metrics.label: Baserunning runs
metrics.desc: Steals (wSB) plus extra bases taken on hits against the league for the same hit, base and outs (builder C).

metrics.label: Extra-base runs
metrics.desc: Runs from taking extra bases on hits.

metrics.label: SB
metrics.desc: Stolen bases: MLB's official line (Stats API); estimated from the pitch data only when no official line is on file.

metrics.label: CS
metrics.desc: Caught stealing: MLB's official line (Stats API); estimated from the pitch data only when no official line is on file.

metrics.label: WAR
metrics.desc: Bullpen WAR (regressed): (batting + baserunning + fielding + framing + positional + league + replacement runs) / runs per win, with batting from regressed park-neutral xwOBA+.

metrics.label: WAR (results)
metrics.desc: Bullpen WAR with results-based batting runs (wOBA, park-adjusted) in place of the regressed xwOBA+ batting runs.

metrics.label: Batting runs
metrics.desc: True-talent batting runs: park-neutral xwOBA+ regressed with the stabilisation PA, against the league, per PA.

metrics.label: Positional runs
metrics.desc: Positional adjustment prorated by games at each position.

metrics.label: Projected wOBA
metrics.desc: Next-season wOBA from the component projections (each skill regressed at its own rate, aging applied).

metrics.label: Preseason projected wOBA
metrics.desc: The projection made before this season from earlier seasons only.
